title: Sharper Shades
text:
Ambush and Fan of Knives reworked.

• Ambush now adds 3 combo points (was 2) and costs 35 energy (was 55)
• Fan of Knives has no cooldown and costs 35 energy (was 45, with a 5 second cooldown)
✨ Fan of Knives adds a combo point for every enemy it hits: hit three players and you get three combo points (up to the usual 5)
